about: v2 held-out cases for evidence-check, written on 2026-11-12 after SKILL.md v0.2 was frozen and before any model saw them. Fictional DemoClub Build Weekend documents in sources/ (B02 amends B01; B03 is a Chinese FAQ that already includes the amendment). 'questions' are free-answer tasks (Mode A); 'drafts' are unsplit drafts to check (Mode B). Tokens: a string of digits or a clock time is compared with the numbers in the answer; any other string is a case-insensitive substring with spaces removed; a list means any one of them. 'gold' quotes: for a question, the passages relevant to it; for a supported draft item, the quotes that support it; for an unsupported draft item, the real sentence a careless checker would most likely cite (empty when there is none). Labels were fixed when the cases were written, before any model saw them.

Lunch and dinner are provided on Saturday, and breakfast and lunch on Sunday, with vegetarian and halal options. Remember that the building closes at midnight on Saturday, so you cannot stay overnight. Project submission closes at 14:00 on Sunday, and demos start at 14:30. See you soon!

Projects that were started before the event are welcome if the team declares the existing code. A team can win at most one prize, and there is no third-place prize.
